note_standalone_within_40km: Five Dragon Pool (12 km from Xikou): not in Xikou's town/Xuedou bounds; Hemudu, Shanglin, Liangshanbo, Siming spots: outside Ningbo urban metro; no destination within 40 km claims them. All Zhejiang destinations are new; no overlap expected.
